text: {"defects": ["The shopping cart icon badge in the top right header displays '0' even though there are items in the cart.", "The 'Total products' and 'Grand Total' amounts (US$219.50) do not match the sum of the item subtotals (US$28.00 + US$42.50 + US$129.00 = US$199.50).", "The 'Grand Total' label and amount have very low contrast against the background, making them hard to read."]}

defects: The shopping cart icon badge in the top right header displays '0' even though there are items in the cart.
The 'Total products' and 'Grand Total' amounts (US$219.50) do not match the sum of the item subtotals (US$28.00 + US$42.50 + US$129.00 = US$199.50).
The 'Grand Total' label and amount have very low contrast against the background, making them hard to read.
